CustomField.description: This fielsd is created for showing requests( My Reqquests, My Open Requests, My Closed requests views) which are created by User, Owned or assigned current user as sales Rep.
CustomField.formula: IF($User.FirstName + ' ' + $User.LastName == Owner:User.FirstName + ' ' + Owner:User.LastName || $User.FirstName + ' ' + $User.LastName == Sales_Rep__r.FirstName + ' ' + Sales_Rep__r.LastName || $User.FirstName + ' ' + $User.LastName == CreatedBy.FirstName + ' ' + CreatedBy.LastName, true, false)
